'''Blackwing Two''' was the callsign used by an unknown [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Viamarr 4]].

==History==
{{Quote|Blackwing Flight, break off and return to station. That's an order.|Velery Station to Blackwing Flight|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
During her visit to [[Viamarr 4]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]], the [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']] launched two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] designated as [[Gray Flight (New Republic)|Gray Flight]] to buzz the capital city of [[Velery]]. Unbeknownst to the locals, the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]-aligned ship had been captured by [[Wraith Squadron]], a newly formed commando squadron of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Velery Station]] tried to impose its will on Gray Flight, which consisted of [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Falynn Sandskimmer]], by instructing it to land at Velery's spaceport. When Gray Flight refused, Blackwing Flight tailed Gray Flight in their [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] and tried to force them to comply with Velery Station's orders.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" //>

What ensued was a tense mock dogfight, during which Gray Flight outmaneuvered and got into firing position behind [[Blackwing One]]. The engagement ended with no casualties when Blackwing Flight was recalled by Velery Station.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" //>
